spec_theorems.name: run_one_output
spec_theorems.informal: For exactly one pathname operand, basename writes exactly one output line containing the documented resulting pathname component.

spec_theorems.name: run_one_output_length
spec_theorems.informal: For exactly one pathname operand, successful basename output consists of exactly one line.

spec_theorems.name: run_one_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: A basename invocation with exactly one operand completes successfully with exit code zero.

spec_theorems.name: run_one_stdin_ignored
spec_theorems.informal: Basename does not use standard input, so changing stdin does not change its result.

spec_theorems.name: output_length_bound
spec_theorems.informal: The modeled utility produces at most one output line for every argument list.
